evals.prompt: Create a Factorio 2.1 mod that adds a new item called 'quantum-alloy', a recipe to craft it from iron and copper plates, and a technology to unlock the recipe. Include proper info.json and locale files.
evals.expected_output: A complete mod structure with data.lua containing the item, recipe, and technology prototypes, plus info.json and locale files (en + de).

assertions.text: info.json exists with name, version, factorio_version 2.1, dependencies
Item prototype defined with type, name, icon, stack_size
Recipe uses categories = {"crafting"} array, NOT category = "crafting" (deprecated in 2.0+)
Technology unlocks the recipe with prerequisites
Prototypes split into prototypes/ folder with require() in data.lua
Locale files present for both en/ and de/
No use of deprecated 'global' table — uses 'storage' instead

evals.prompt: I want to add a new planet called 'Glacius' to Factorio 2.1 Space Age. It should be a cold ice planet with low gravity, high magnetic field, unique resources, and a space connection from Nauvis. Show me the prototype code.
evals.expected_output: Complete planet prototype, space connection, technology to unlock it, and planet-specific resources/entities.

assertions.text: Planet prototype with type='planet' and surface_properties
Space connection from nauvis to planet with asteroid definitions
Surface properties: gravity, magnetic-field, solar-power, pressure, day-night-cycle
Platform procession set and planet procession set defined
Asteroid spawn definitions for the space connection

evals.prompt: Build a custom GUI window for my Factorio 2.1 mod that shows the player's current production statistics (items crafted, buildings placed) with tabs for different views and a refresh button. Add it to the top bar.
evals.expected_output: A complete control.lua with GUI creation, event handling, and top bar integration.

assertions.text: Top bar button added in on_init and on_player_created

evals.prompt: Create a Factorio mod where an assembling machine only operates when a circuit signal (signal-A > 100) is present. Write the control.lua that monitors the circuit network and enables/disables the machine accordingly.
evals.expected_output: Runtime code that reads circuit signals and controls entity behavior based on threshold.

assertions.text: Controls entity via disabled_by_script (NOT writing to entity.active which is read-only since 2.0)

evals.prompt: Write a Factorio 2.1 control.lua that disables an assembling machine when its circuit network reads signal-A > 100. Also show me how to make an entity not minable by players and how to read the fluid in a machine's fluidbox.
evals.expected_output: Code that correctly uses 2.1 API: disabled_by_script instead of entity.active, minable_flag instead of entity.minable, and direct fluid methods instead of fluidbox.

assertions.text: Uses disabled_by_script = true/false, NOT entity.active = false (read-only since 2.0)
Uses minable_flag = false, NOT entity.minable = false (write removed since 2.0)
Checks entity.valid before accessing stored entity references
Uses storage not global for persistent data
Does NOT use entity.neighbors (removed), uses specific neighbour properties if needed

evals.prompt: Create a Factorio 2.1 recipe for a 'quantum-circuit' that can be crafted in both 'crafting' and 'advanced-crafting' categories. Also create the assembling machine prototype that supports both categories.
evals.expected_output: Recipe using categories = {"crafting", "advanced-crafting"} array syntax (not the deprecated category/additional_categories).

assertions.text: Does NOT use category = "crafting" (deprecated, crashes on load in 2.0+)

evals.prompt: I want to create a programmable speaker in my Factorio 2.1 mod that plays a sound globally across all surfaces. Show me the prototype definition.

assertions.text: Does NOT use the deprecated "Global" playback mode
